title: FBI-UAP-D001, FD-302, Unresolved UAP Report, Colorado Springs, 2022
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview report detailing a 2022 UAP sighting by five military personnel near Fort Carson, Colorado.

incidents.summary: Five military personnel observed a motionless, bean-shaped, matte white object hovering over a saddle in Cheyenne Mountain near Fort Carson.
incidents.explanation: Witnesses considered possibilities such as a blimp or weather balloon but remained uncertain.
incidents.quote: The object was completely motionless and no sound could be heard coming from it.
incidents.size: 10% of the saddle of the mountain
